relationships.evidence: EPDItaly uses qualified reusable calculation models to streamline subsequent EPD verification and publication.
relationships.constraints: Qualification is scoped to defined tool versions, inputs and programme rules.
relationships.validation_question: Retain qualification identifier and rule version on every generated declaration.

relationships.evidence: EPDItaly construction declarations follow EN 15804 programme rules.
relationships.constraints: Other product categories and programme transitions may use different rule sets.
relationships.validation_question: Record the applicable PCR and EN 15804 edition per declaration.

relationships.evidence: EPDItaly is a Type III EPD programme governed by ISO 14025 principles.
relationships.constraints: Programme transition from the withdrawn 2006 edition to the 2026 edition requires confirmation.
relationships.validation_question: Document the formal transition timetable and affected procedures.
